critique: The core look remains recognizable: a luminous pastel-blue magical particle plane spans the frame against clean black negative space, with a gently changing wave profile between t1 and t4. However, large soft-focus particles still break the refined planar silhouette, especially at the edges and in the upper/lower foreground at t4. The plane also has too much apparent depth, producing distracting particles far above and below the intended horizon band rather than a controlled, elegant sheet.

suggestions.why: Reduce the maximum particle size so near-camera particles no longer read as oversized bokeh blobs.
Compress the emitter depth range to keep particles concentrated around the plane instead of scattering large foreground particles throughout the frame.
